meaning:
έξ-ολεθρεύω
(so best MSS. and WH; also read -οθρεύω), [in LXX frequently (rare in Gk. writers) for כָּרַת ni., hi., etc. ;]
to destroy utterly: before ἐκ τ. λαοῦ, Act.3:23 (LXX).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
